identity.name: Clone X
identity.notes: Clone X collection preserved in the RTFKT archive after RTFKT operations wound down. Official holder-gated 3D-file access survives as an archival/download surface; exact per-token VRM inventory still must be enumerated rather than inferred.

evidence.note: Official RTFKT Medium profile lists discord.gg/rtfkt.
RTFKT's official link hub retains its Twitter/X destination and Clone X collection link.
Contemporaneous Nov. 29, 2021 report states Clone X drops that day.
OpenSea displays the collection launch period as Dec 2021; the catalog uses Nov. 29 as the public drop date and preserves this month-boundary discrepancy in evidence.

storage.note: RTFKT's documented distribution mechanism is its authenticated holder inventory/Clone X download surface. This describes delivery/storage availability, not the underlying CDN/object-store implementation.

evidence.note: Clone X is listed among RTFKT collections with 3D files and Clone X downloads are directed to clonex.rtfkt.com.

ip_rights.summary: RTFKT documents commercial rights for Clone X 3D files and requires holders to register their Clone for commercial-license use under the applicable 3D-model commercial-license guidelines. Rights are therefore holder-linked and governed by the RTFKT license terms rather than unrestricted public-domain rights.

evidence.note: Official documentation states the 3D library includes commercial rights and instructs Clone X holders to register their Clone for commercial licensing.
RTFKT states Clone X was built in full 3D and that Clone IP commercial rights accompanied the collection.

file_access.note: Official RTFKT documentation says holders access 3D files by authenticating with their RTFKT account/wallet; Clone X is specifically downloaded from the Clone X holder surface. Exact per-token VRM URLs still need enumeration from authenticated inventory and are not fabricated here.

project_status.note: RTFKT announced its operational wind-down for the end of January 2025. The current RTFKT site is presented as an archive and retained download/service surfaces should be treated as preservation infrastructure, not evidence that the operating project remains active.

evidence.note: Current site is organized around THE ARCHIVES and retained 3D-file/legal resources.
Reports RTFKT's official announcement that operations would wind down by January 2025.
